effect_description_eng:
＜Armor Purge＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, you may trash the top card of this Digimon to prevent that deletion.)
[When Digivolving] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gains ＜Security A. -1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.) until the end of your opponent's turn.
